events.text: Quality-first Agent Factory activated. New agents require proven capability gap and independent A/B evaluation.
Created canonical Agent Blueprint with mission, non-goals, trigger, tools, permissions, memory, output contract, eval and retirement rules.
Created Quality-First Agent Factory skill and candidate lifecycle: Core+Skill → Sandbox → A/B Eval → Promote/Merge/Delete.
Agent Factory CI run 35488125161 passed JavaScript syntax and Agent Factory contract checks.
Cloudflare deployment blocker is missing authorization/access, not a capability gap. No new Agent is justified.
Consequential writes now require Idempotency-Key; job/approval + audit + idempotency record use transactional D1 batch.
CI run 35435245952 proved same-key retries do not duplicate jobs, approvals or audit events.
RND-RUNTIME-001 recorded as CI-validated, but skill promotion is withheld until remote D1 staging replay test passes.
Regression detected: CI run 35435087962 failed deterministic seed check after normal Agent status changes.
Bootstrap seed incorrectly included volatile runtime state (status/currentJob/learningState).
Separated stable Agent identity/config from volatile runtime state; seed now normalizes agents to READY.
New rule: bootstrap artifacts must contain durable configuration only; live state belongs to runtime/event storage.
GitHub Actions run 35435028739 passed frontend syntax, Worker syntax, seed consistency, foundation, SQLite/D1 compatibility and runtime contract tests.
Remote staging deployment is the only current Phase 2B blocker: verified Cloudflare account/API token/D1 ID are not available in connected tools.
Cycle closed as DEPLOY-READY, not LIVE. Production write remains OFF.
Immediate command received; Phase 2B work started without waiting for the 4-hour fallback.
Verified current Cloudflare D1 flow: execute schema/seed remotely, then deploy Worker.
